sets.relationshipLabel: two names for the same kind of puppet
sets.explanation: A marionette is simply another name for a string puppet, just as a glove puppet is another name for a hand puppet — each pair is one puppet type under two labels.

sets.relationshipLabel: the worker and the tool of their trade
sets.explanation: A carver works with a chisel just as a marionettist works with a control bar — each craftsperson is defined by the tool in their hand.
baitTags: marionettist echoes marionette from the synonymity set

sets.relationshipLabel: the start and finish of a process
sets.explanation: A rough-cut ends in a polish and an audition ends in a curtain call — each pair marks the first rough attempt and the final finished moment of the same undertaking.

sets.relationshipLabel: the covering that hides the true thing beneath it
sets.explanation: Blacks are worn to hide the puppeteer from the audience's eye, just as a glove hides the hand that fills it — in both pairs the visible cover conceals the real actor underneath.
baitTags: glove/hand echo glove puppet/hand puppet from the synonymity set
